product.name: Dark Matter Hyper-K Wireless Ultralight Gaming Mouse
product.description: Dark Matter™ by Monoprice™Hyper-K Wireless Ultralight Gaming MousePixArt® Optical Sensor and Offers Six Programmable DPI Settings Ranging from 800 to 16,000 DPIThe Dark Matter Hyper-K Wireless Ultralight Gaming Mouse with 16,000 DPI uses PixArt optical sensor. The Hyper-K wireless offers six predefined programmable settings ranging from 800 to 16,000 DPI with corresponding LEDs of red, green, blue, purple yellow and cyan colors. The rechargeable battery has a capacity of 300mAh and will operate up to 50 hours without LED enabled. The Dark Matter Hyper-K is a full size, ultra lightweight gaming mouse that utilizes a strong honeycomb structure, along with other design innovations, to achieve an ultra light weight of 2.5oz. The compatible operating systems are Windows XP, 2000, Vista/7/8/9/10, and MacOS.Fast and reliable 2.4GHz wireless technologyUltra lightweight at 2.5ozSix programmable DPI settings, ranging from 800 to 16,000 DPILED lighting effects; red, green, blue, purple yellow and cyan colorsOmron switchesUltralight honeycomb build300mAh batteryUp to 50 hours of use on a single charge INDUSTRY-LEADING OPTICAL SENSORThe 16,000 DPI PixArt PAW 3335 Optical Sensor delivers accurate tracking for pinpoint precision. 6 SELECTABLE DPI SETTINGSGet full control of your DPI with 6 selectable DPI settings. You can find the exact tracking for your needs and playing style, with fully customizable RGB. FAST AND RELIABLE 2.4GHZ WIRELESS CONNECTION2.4GHz wireless connectivity means that you will get amazing responsiveness with minimal lag. STELLAR BATTERY LIFEBoasting a 300mAh built-in battery, the Dark Matter Hyper-K will support up to 50 hours of continuous use (without LED) for extended gaming sessions. ULTRA LIGHTWEIGHTForm and function come together with the ultralight honeycomb build that not only looks and feels great, but allows for an ultra light weight of just 2.5oz. PACKAGE CONTENTS• 1x Hyper-K Wireless Mouse • 1x 2.4GHz USB Wireless Receiver • 1x USB Type-A to Type-C Cable 1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
